patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient was brought to the emergency department by police after he was found undressing himself outside in extremely hot weather. The patient is uncooperative, refusing to answer questions due to paranoia about being spied on. He has a history of polysubstance abuse and a recent visit to the ED for intoxication.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Recently started college. Known history of substance use.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Unable to obtain due to patient's non-compliance and altered mental status.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage the patient presenting with altered mental status, autonomic dysregulation, and muscle rigidity.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “ I don’t feel safe—people are watching me. I’m very hot and confused, I can barely stay awake, and I’ve had episodes where my body feels stiff and my behavior gets out of control.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you often find yourself needing to rush to the bathroom to urinate, or feeling like you have to go right away?
turns.patient_answer: “Not that—I’m more focused on feeling watched. I’m mostly too confused to notice anything like urination, but I’ve been extremely hot, very sleepy, and I’ve had stiffness episodes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any firm lumps or masses in your breast tissue, perhaps something that feels harder than the surrounding area?
turns.patient_answer: “No—nothing like that. I’m just terrified and overheated, I can barely keep my eyes open, and I’ve had moments where my muscles feel rigid and I can’t control what I’m doing.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any small, firm bumps on your skin that are smooth to the touch?
turns.patient_answer: “No—no bumps or lumps on my skin. I’m just extremely hot, confused, and I can barely stay awake, with episodes where my muscles get rigid and I lose control.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling like you just can't seem to cool down lately, even when you're in a cool environment or not doing anything physically demanding?
turns.patient_answer: “Yeah—I can’t cool down. Even in shade and cooler air I feel intensely overheated, and I get very sleepy and confused. Sometimes my muscles get stiff and I can’t control my actions.”

turns.doctor_question: How have you been feeling lately, emotionally speaking? Have you been experiencing a lot of stress or anxiety in your daily life?
turns.patient_answer: “I feel terrified—like people are watching and spying on me, so I’m on edge all the time. With it, I get intensely overheated, very sleepy, confused, and I’ve had episodes where my muscles turn stiff and I can’t control my behavior.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching sensations on your skin lately, either all over or in specific areas?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I don’t really have itching—I’m too hot and confused, and I’m mostly focused on feeling watched. My main problem is that I can’t seem to cool down, I get very sleepy, and sometimes my muscles go stiff and I lose control.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots or rashes along the veins on your arms?
turns.patient_answer: “No— I haven’t noticed any unusual spots or rashes along my arms. I’m just extremely overheated, very sleepy, and confused, and I get episodes where my muscles turn stiff and I can’t control my behavior.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you're having trouble finding the right words when you want to express yourself, like a word is stuck on the tip of your tongue and you just can't quite remember it?
turns.patient_answer: “No, it’s not like I can’t find words—I’m too overheated and very sleepy, and then I get confused. When it happens, my muscles can go stiff and my behavior gets out of control, and I’m mostly trying to focus on feeling watched.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any stiffness or resistance in your muscles when moving or being moved, such as feeling like your muscles are tight or hard to relax?
turns.patient_answer: “Yes—my muscles get tight and hard, and they’re very stiff when I try to move or when someone touches me. It feels like I can’t relax or control my body, and I end up very sleepy and confused.”

turns.doctor_question: How's your energy level been today? Have you felt unusually sleepy or struggled to stay awake, even when you were doing things you normally enjoy or needed to focus on?
turns.patient_answer: “Yeah, I’ve been unusually sleepy—I can barely stay awake, even when I’m trying to focus, and I get hot and confused. It comes in waves where I feel drowsy and then my muscles stiffen and I can’t control what I’m doing.”

turns.doctor_question: How would you describe the warmth in your legs - do they feel warm to you, or do they feel cooler than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “My legs feel extremely hot—warmer than usual, like I can’t get cool no matter where I am. I’m very sleepy and confused, and my muscles can suddenly stiffen and I lose control of what I’m doing.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find that you're coughing up mucus or phlegm, or is your cough mostly dry?
turns.patient_answer: “No—I’m not coughing up mucus or phlegm, and my main issue is being extremely overheated, very sleepy and confused, and then having episodes where my muscles get rigid and I can’t control my behavior.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any rough, scaly patches on your skin lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No—there haven’t been any rough, scaly patches. I’m mostly just extremely hot, very sleepy and confused, and I get episodes where my muscles stiffen and I can’t control my behavior, and I feel like people are watching me.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any unusual spots, rashes, or skin growths on your body that don't hurt or bother you when you touch them?
turns.patient_answer: “No—no unusual spots or rashes that don’t hurt. I’m mostly just extremely hot and very sleepy, and my muscles can suddenly become stiff and I can’t control what I do.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you drink alcohol, or have you had a drink recently?
turns.patient_answer: “Yeah—I’ve had alcohol and other substances recently, and I’ve had episodes after being intoxicated. I can’t really explain details well—I’m too hot, very sleepy, and confused, and I feel like people are watching me.”
